subject: Inquiry for LED Panel Light - 3000pcs
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

We are interested in your LED Panel Light (Model: PL-6060, 40W, 600x600mm).

Quantity: 3,000 pcs
Target price: USD 12.50/pc FOB Ningbo
Please send your quotation before 2026-09-15.

Best regards,
Michael Chen
Procurement Manager
Global Import Ltd.
note: 标准英文询盘，格式规范——规则层应能抽全，作为基线样本

subject: Request quote - aluminum profile
body:
Hello,

We need aluminum profiles for our window system project.
Item: Aluminum Profile AP-2024, anodized silver
Qty: 5,000 meters
Our budget is EUR 8,90 per meter.
Kindly reply by 15th September 2026.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Klaus Weber
Bauhaus Material GmbH
note: 陷阱1：欧陆数字格式 EUR 8,90（逗号作小数点），与千分位 3,000 易混淆

subject: 铝合金型材询价
body:
你好，

我司需要采购铝合金型材（型号 6063-T5，表面氧化处理）。
数量：500支（每支6米）
目标价格：88元/支
请在2026年9月20日前报价。

杭州华筑装饰工程有限公司
王磊
采购部

expected.customer: 杭州华筑装饰工程有限公司

note: 陷阱2：中文格式（支/元/年月日），规则层需中文单位与日期正则

subject: Office furniture - container order
body:
Hi there,

We'd like to order a full 40HQ container of your office workstation furniture (Model OW-1200).
Please advise the unit price per set and total CIF Felixstowe.
We need the goods delivered by end of October 2026.

Regards,
Sarah Mitchell
UK Interiors Limited
note: 陷阱3：数量隐含在 40HQ 集装箱（无精确数字）、价格待对方报价——测试「诚实缺失」而非瞎猜

subject: Mixed order - tiles and sanitary ware
body:
Dear team,

Please quote for the following:
1) Ceramic floor tile 600x600mm - 2,500 sqm @ USD 6.80/sqm
2) Wall hung toilet CW-880 - 120 sets @ USD 95.00/set
3) Basin mixer tap - 300 pcs, our target USD 22.00/pc

Delivery needed before 2026-10-31.

David Brown
Ausbuild Pty Ltd

expected.product: Ceramic floor tile / Wall hung toilet CW-880 / Basin mixer tap

note: 陷阱4：多产品多数量多价格——规则层易串行错配（数量对不上产品）

subject: RE: Quotation Q-20260815
body:
Hi,

Thanks for your quote. We accept the price of USD 15.20/pc for 1,200 pcs of LED downlight DL-9W.

Please proceed with production. We need shipment by end of next month at the latest.

--- Original message ---
On 2026-08-15 you wrote: "Quantity 800 pcs, price USD 16.00/pc, delivery before 2026-08-30" - please ignore that, the new figures above apply.

James
Nordic Lighting AB
note: 陷阱5（最关键）：正文引用了历史邮件旧数据(800pcs/USD16.00/2026-08-30)。规则层必错，只有 LLM 能识别「以最新数据为准」——这是 LLM 价值的硬证据

subject: Repeat order - same as PO-2026-0432
body:
Hello,

We need to reorder the same items as our previous order PO-2026-0432:
- Acoustic ceiling panel 600x600, 1,800 sqm

Please arrange production, we need it before November 20, 2026.
Price as per previous contract.

Lisa
Canada Decor Inc.
note: 价格「按前合同」未写明——测试缺失识别；含 PO 号干扰项，规则层可能把 PO-2026-0432 当订单号误抽

subject: 办公椅采购
body:
各位好，

需要采购人体工学办公椅（型号 EC-360，网布面料），数量 350 张。
含税单价 ¥580.00/张，需要开13%增值税专用发票。
交货期：2026年11月10日前。

深圳市舒座家具有限公司
陈静

expected.customer: 深圳市舒座家具有限公司

note: 中文 + ¥符号 + 「13%增值税」干扰（规则层可能把 13% 当价格相关数字）
